scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node --import tsx scripts/prerender.tsx && vite build --config vite.canvas.config.ts && node --import tsx scripts/prerender-canvas.tsx
scripts.check: npm run test:canvas && npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- ../app/templates/index.html ../app/static/workbench ../app/templates/canvas.html ../app/static/canvas
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts vite.config.ts vite.canvas.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts vite.config.ts vite.canvas.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html
